If one of these colonies has 53 worker ants, which of the following is closest to the predicted number of larvae in the colony?

In triangle DEF, the measure of angle D is 40° and the measure of angle E is 95°. In triangle RST, the measure of angle R is 40° and the measure of angle S is 95°. Which of the following additional pieces of information is needed to determine whether triangle DEF is similar to triangle RST?
choices: The measure of angle F and the measure of angle T
questions.verified: two pairs of congruent angles already establish similarity (AA)

questions.stem: The function \(f(x)=\frac{1}{9}(x-4)^{2}+5\) gives a toy car's height above the ground f(x), in inches, x seconds after it started moving on an elevated track, where \(0\le x\le 10\). Which of the following is the best interpretation of the vertex of the graph of \(y=f(x)\) in the xy-plane?
choices: The toy car's minimum height was 5 inches above the ground.
The toy car's minimum height was 4 inches above the ground.
The toy car's height was 5 inches above the ground when it started moving.
The toy car's height was 4 inches above the ground when it started moving.
questions.verified: vertex (4,5); leading coefficient 1/9 > 0 so the vertex is a minimum of 5 inches

questions.stem: The function \(f(t)=30{,}000(2)^{\frac{t}{370}}\) gives the number of bacteria in a population t minutes after an initial observation. How much time, in minutes, does it take for the number of bacteria in the population to double?
questions.verified: base 2 doubles when the exponent increases by 1, i.e. t = 370

questions.stem: The edge length, in inches, of cube Y is \(\frac{3}{64}\) the edge length, in inches, of cube X. The surface area, in square inches, of cube Y is n times the surface area, in square inches, of cube X. What is the value of n?
questions.verified: surface area scales with the square of the linear ratio: (3/64)^2 = 9/4096
